screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a star with its circumstellar habitable zone and an orbiting planet.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has controls for the star and the planet's orbit, plus a Reset All button that returns the screen to its starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Adjust the star and the orbit to see how the circumstellar habitable zone changes.

circumstellar.currentDetails: The screen is in its initial state.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows the Milky Way galaxy and the band that forms its galactic habitable zone.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has controls for the factors that govern galactic habitability, plus a Reset All button that returns the screen to its starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Adjust the factors to see how the galactic habitable zone changes.

galactic.currentDetails: The screen is in its initial state.
